news_items.title: Commission preliminary finds TikTok in breach of Digital Services Act for failing to ensure safe accounts for minors | Shaping Europe’s digital future
news_items.snippet: Today, the European Commission sent TikTok preliminary findings indicating that TikTok accounts of minors do not meet the safety standards required under the Digital Services Act (DSA).

classification.reasoning: The article discusses preliminary findings from the European Commission indicating that TikTok is in breach of the Digital Services Act regarding the safety of accounts for minors, which represents a status change in the enforcement of this existing regulation.
classification.summary: The European Commission has found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act for not ensuring safe accounts for minors.

news_items.title: Government of Canada introduces legislation to make social media services and AI chatbots safer for children - Canada.ca
news_items.source: Canadian Heritage Safe Social Media Act
news_items.snippet: Legislation would make social media services and AI chatbot services accountable for developing services that are safe by design and that put the safety of children first

classification.reasoning: The article discusses the introduction of new legislation aimed at making social media services and AI chatbots safer for children, indicating that this is a new regulatory proposal.
